source.title: Some open problems in mutual stationarity involving inner model theory: a commentary.

accepted.question_text: Let ⟨κ_α | α < δ⟩ be an increasing sequence of uncountable regular cardinals, let κ = sup_α κ_α, and fix a regular cardinal λ < κ_0. For each α < δ, let S_α be a stationary subset of κ_α ∩ {ξ ∈ Ord : cf(ξ) = λ}. Call the sequence ⟨S_α | α < δ⟩ mutually stationary when the set {X ∈ [κ]^λ | sup(X ∩ κ_α) ∈ S_α} is stationary, and write MS(⟨κ_α⟩_{α<δ}, λ) for the assertion that every such sequence is mutually stationary. What is the consistency strength of MS(⟨ω_n | n < ω⟩, ω_1), optionally together with the Continuum Hypothesis?
accepted.context_brief: Mutual stationarity on the sequence of ω_n at cofinality ω_1

evidence.quote: Definition 1 Let S = hSα|α < δi be a sequence of stationary sets, with Sα ⊆ κα ∩ cofλ (λ < κ0). Then S is mutually stationary if the following set S is stationary: S =df {X ∈ [κ] λ | sup(X ∩ κα) ∈ Sα}. Let MS(hκαiα<δ, λ) abbreviate: For all sequences S = hSα|α < δi, with Sα ⊆ κα ∩ cofλ, and Sα stationaryi, S is mutually stationary.
Question 1 What is the consistency strength of MS(hωnin<ω, ω1)(+CH)?

accepted.question_text: Let ⟨λ_n | n < ω⟩ be an increasing sequence of regular cardinals such that infinitely many of the λ_n are not Mahlo, and let γ < λ_0 be regular. Using the same notion MS(⟨κ_α⟩_{α<δ}, λ) of mutual stationarity from Definition 1, what is the consistency strength of MS(⟨λ_n | n < ω⟩, γ)?
accepted.context_brief: Mutual stationarity for a small increasing sequence of regular cardinals

evidence.quote: Let hλnin<ω be an ascending sequence of regular cardinals, with infinitely many not Mahlo. Let γ < λ0 be regular.
Question 2 What is the consistency strength of MS(hλain<ω, γ)

accepted.question_text: For A ⊆ ω, define S_A = {X ∈ [ℵ_ω]^{ω_1} | for every m > 1, cf(sup(X ∩ ω_m)) = ω when m ∈ A and cf(sup(X ∩ ω_m)) = ω_1 when m ∉ A}. Assume that A contains successor pairs n, n+1 infinitely often and also omits successor pairs n, n+1 infinitely often. What is the consistency strength of the statement that S_A is stationary for some such A?
accepted.context_brief: Alternating cofinality patterns in S_A on [ℵ_ω]^{ω_1}

evidence.quote: If A ⊆ ω, then let us define: SA =df { X ∈ [ℵω]ω1 | ∀m > 1 cf(sup(X ∩ ωm)) = ω if m ∈ A ω1 if m 6∈ A }.
Question 3 What is the consistency strength of "For some A ⊆ ω which infinitely often both contains and omits successor pairs n, n + 1 of integers, SA is stationary."?

accepted.question_text: Let A ⊆ ω be as in Question 3, and let S_A = {X ∈ [ℵ_ω]^{ω_1} | for every m > 1, cf(sup(X ∩ ω_m)) = ω when m ∈ A and cf(sup(X ∩ ω_m)) = ω_1 when m ∉ A}. If S_A is stationary for a single such A, must there exist an inner model with a strong cardinal?
accepted.context_brief: Conjectured lower bound from the stationary-set pattern in Question 3

evidence.quote: If A ⊆ ω, then let us define: SA =df { X ∈ [ℵω]ω1 | ∀m > 1 cf(sup(X ∩ ωm)) = ω if m ∈ A ω1 if m 6∈ A }.
Conjecture: If for a single A as in Question 3, SA is stationary, then there is an inner model with a strong cardinal.
